faces.transcription:
DOOR 14
You hear a knock at the door. You rush to open it, but there’s no one there. Staring at you is a single black briefcase marked with the New Zealand flag.
What do you do?
Open the briefcase: Open Door 19.
Blow it up: Open Door 24.
Ignore it: Put this card in the reserve until you decide what to do with it.
